data.pattern_semantics: No forbidden word pattern; regular decreasing labelled binary trees strictly decreasing to the left, with first-occurrence nodes equal to the first in-order node plus nodes having a left child.
data.statement: In-order traversal restricts to a size-preserving bijection from Fishburn trees to modified ascent sequences; recursive splitting at the leftmost maximum is its inverse.
